title: Sphere leaves in eight seconds

tellings.quote: But when that thing took off, within 8 seconds of the time I spotted the sweepand till the time the thing was a pinpoint of light in a night sky, 8 seconds had elapsed.

plain: Charlie Foltz, one of a group of men on a 1976 canoe trip on Eagle Lake in Maine's Allagash Waterway, says a glowing sphere they saw took off so fast that just 8 seconds passed between his spotting it and its shrinking to a pinpoint of light in the night sky. Foltz tells Michels he saw it himself. Few known aircraft could do that.
